name: 方旭偉
objective:
邀請校內外學者專家至校針對某一專長領域進行專題演講，讓學生藉由聽講及心得報告之寫作，開展視野，並與時代之脈動相契合
Invited speakers from different disciplines give speech in their specialized area. Thus students can broaden their eyesight and also keep updating the technology and its applications of the generation.
schedule:
課程安排分為兩部分：
1. 邀請專家專題演講 (8~10 場）
2. 研究生個別專題報告
The course is divided to two parts:
1. Speech from invited speakers (8-10 speakers)
2. Individual oral presentation from graduate student

彈性教學週活動規劃
實施期間 Period: 17 & 18 weeks
實施方式 Content: 非同步遠距教學 Asynchronous Distance Learning
彈性教學評量方式 Evaluation: 線上測驗或作業
成績考核 Performance Evaluation: 彈性教學：10%
scorePolicy:
1. 心得報告 （30%)
2. 口頭報告 (40%)
3. 平時成績 (30%)

1. Written report (30%)
2. Oral presentation (40%)
3. Class performance (30%)
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



無
延伸教學與資源:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標:
SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）
SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）
SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI:
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
